title: I made an AI RPG with an open world, an image for every scene, and AI NPCs who have jobs
author: Prestigious_Ad_3492
selftext:
After playing with AI image generators and text-based AI RPGs, I realised the two could do much more together.

I didn't want an LLM that just narrates a story.   
  
I wanted an open world like the ones in 3D games, filled with AI NPCs.  
  
 \- I started with one world. Now there are 11.

 \- To keep the scope manageable, I went with a small-town format, like Stardew Valley.

 \- You can rest or sleep to pass time, like in Red Dead Redemption.

 \- You can switch the camera between first person and third person.

\- NPCs can visit you at any time of day, and you get a notification when they do (Android only for now).

This is still early, and I have a long list of ideas for where this world can go. What would you want to see in a game like this?

Try it free:

comments.author: pricetag
comments.body: what is the plot? just chatting with an llm? how is this even a game

replies.author: Prestigious_Ad_3492
replies.body:
I haven't introduced a good story yet. I am working on that part to be honest.

I am doing it in steps, right now it is more like a cozy small town to live in and yes, chat with people in it.

replies.body: I think you are right, I will work on the gameplay more now.

replies.author: Every-Prize4720
replies.body: but but but player can click this one button. what more do they want???

comments.author: pickleunicorn
comments.body: I think the main issue will probably be the fact that LLM aren't really good writers. I think it would be way better to write a story yourself, create good NPCs with exhaustive personality, load that into an LLM so we can interact directly talk with the NPC, so the immersion would be better.

replies.author: Prestigious_Ad_3492
replies.body: Agreed they are not, I will work on an original story now. Let's see how it goes. Thanks!
